title: Pupils Redistribution
statementMd:
In Berland each high school student is characterized by *academic performance* — integer value between $1$ and $5$.

In high school `0xFF` there are two groups of pupils: the group $*A*$ and the group $*B*$. Each group consists of exactly $*n*$ students. An academic performance of each student is known — integer value between $1$ and $5$.

The school director wants to redistribute students between groups so that each of the two groups has the same number of students whose academic performance is equal to $1$, the same number of students whose academic performance is $2$ and so on. In other words, the purpose of the school director is to change the composition of groups, so that for each value of academic performance the numbers of students in both groups are equal.

To achieve this, there is a plan to produce a series of exchanges of students between groups. During the single exchange the director selects one student from the class $*A*$ and one student of class $*B*$. After that, they both change their groups.

Print the least number of exchanges, in order to achieve the desired equal numbers of students for each academic performance.

## Input

The first line of the input contains integer number $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$) — number of students in both groups.

The second line contains sequence of integer numbers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 5$), where $*a*_{*i*}$ is academic performance of the $*i*$-th student of the group $*A*$.

The third line contains sequence of integer numbers $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *b*_{*i*} ≤ 5$), where $*b*_{*i*}$ is academic performance of the $*i*$-th student of the group $*B*$.

## Output

Print the required minimum number of exchanges or `-1`, if the desired distribution of students can not be obtained.
statementZhMd:
在 Berland，每名高中生都具有一个由整数表示的*学习成绩*，其值介于 $1$ 和 $5$ 之间。

在高中 `0xFF` 中有两个学生组：组 $*A*$ 和组 $*B*$。每组恰好有 $*n*$ 名学生。每名学生的学习成绩都是已知的，且为介于 $1$ 和 $5$ 之间的整数。

校长希望重新分配学生，使得两个组中学习成绩等于 $1$ 的学生人数相同，学习成绩等于 $2$ 的学生人数相同，依此类推。换句话说，校长的目标是改变两个组的组成，使得对于每一种学习成绩，两个组中的学生人数都相等。

为此，计划进行一系列学生交换。在一次交换中，校长从组 $*A*$ 中选择一名学生，并从组 $*B*$ 中选择一名学生。之后，两名学生互换所在的组。

请输出达到每种学习成绩对应的学生人数均相等这一目标所需的最少交换次数。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$)，表示两个组中的学生人数。

第二行包含一个整数序列 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 5$)，其中 $*a*_{*i*}$ 表示组 $*A*$ 中第 $*i*$ 名学生的学习成绩。

第三行包含一个整数序列 $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *b*_{*i*} ≤ 5$)，其中 $*b*_{*i*}$ 表示组 $*B*$ 中第 $*i*$ 名学生的学习成绩。

## 输出格式

输出所需的最少交换次数。如果无法得到所需的学生分布，则输出 `-1`。
